RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot responsibly assign a number from these facts.

An all-male panel is worth questioning as a process issue, but it does not establish that sex influenced the decision. Your longer experience matters; his digital expertise could legitimately outweigh it, depending on the advertised criteria.

Follow up on your unanswered request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting, your assessment against them, and the broadcaster’s policy on panel composition. You can neutrally ask how the panel ensured a fair, unbiased assessment.

More telling signs would include inconsistent criteria, sex-based comments, or departures from recruitment policy. If you suspect discrimination, consult your union or local equality adviser promptly: complaint deadlines may run while you await an explanation.
